name: Sarilus Foulborne's Head
summary: Across the border from the Barrens, Sarilus Foulborne's Head reaches Ashenvale as proof of the sorcerer's death. The undead mage defiled Ashenvale's waters, and the Sentinels demanded his head.

sections.title: A Defiler Silenced
sections.body: Sarilus Foulborne was a Forsaken spellcaster atop Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens. He drew the night elves' anger by corrupting and binding swarms of water elementals. From Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike recognized his work and sent champions across the frontier into Horde territory to end his experiments. Starstrike would accept only his severed head as proof that the mocking mage was dead, and that the troubled waters of Ashenvale might know some peace.

faq.answer: Sarilus Foulborne was an undead mage who established himself atop Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens. He angered the night elves by twisting and summoning vast numbers of water elementals, so Sentinel Velene Starstrike ordered his death.

faq.q: Why does Sentinel Velene Starstrike want his head?
faq.answer: Velene Starstrike wanted certainty that the arrogant sorcerer was dead. Sarilus mocked her while defiling the region's water spirits, and his severed head was the only proof she would accept that the threat had ended.
Sarilus Foulborne lairs atop Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens, just south of the Ashenvale border.

faq.q: Why was Foulborne defiling water elementals?
faq.answer: Sarilus Foulborne used arcane summonings to bend numerous water elementals to his will and corrupt them. His reckless manipulation disrupted the natural balance of waters flowing near Ashenvale, drawing swift retaliation from the Sentinels.

angles.text: Taking Foulborne's head answers the Sentinels' vengeance against an arcane defiler who desecrated the spirits of the land.
This strike requires infiltrating deep into hostile Horde lands in the Barrens to eliminate a dangerous rogue caster.
